column1: # Model textures that emit light (tools/emissive_layer.py --models): PATH in MODELS.dat, intensity, note.
# Props the original lights with the model light (entity.dat lighting 1, RF_DIRLIGHT) but that get no fill light
# (QindieGL lights characters only near the camera) come out nearly black under path tracing.
# Neon signs drawn as plain models (entity.dat lighting 0) glow in the original from their bright texture alone
# and stay dull under path tracing.
